grammar.label: should / shouldn't / ought to — advice
grammar.form: should / shouldn't / ought to + base verb

explanation.en: 'ought to' means the same as 'should' but is a little more formal. Neither takes 'to' after should.
explanation.uz: 'ought to' — 'should' bilan bir xil, biroz rasmiyroq. 'should' dan keyin 'to' YO'Q.

grammar.negative_example: You should to see a doctor.

grammar.label: must / have to / don't have to / mustn't
grammar.meaning: internal obligation, external obligation, no obligation, prohibition

explanation.en: must = I feel it is necessary. have to = someone else requires it. mustn't = forbidden. don't have to = not necessary.
explanation.uz: must = o'zim zarur deb bilaman. have to = boshqa birov talab qiladi. mustn't = TAQIQLANGAN. don't have to = shart emas.

grammar.positive_example: I don't have to work on Sunday.
grammar.negative_example: I mustn't work on Sunday. (meaning: it isn't necessary)

l1_notes.uz: 'mustn't' va 'don't have to' — QARAMA-QARSHI ma'no. Bu eng ko'p chalkashtiriladigan juftlik.

grammar.label: had to / didn't have to — past obligation
grammar.form: had to / didn't have to + base verb

explanation.en: 'must' has no past form. Use 'had to' instead.
explanation.uz: 'must' ning o'tgan zamon shakli YO'Q — uning o'rniga 'had to' ishlatiladi.

grammar.positive_example: I had to work last Saturday.

body.text: I feel dizzy and my head hurts.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: You should sit down. How do you feel now?

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: For one day. I also have a stomachache.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: You must go to the doctor. You mustn't wait.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Do I have to go today?

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: You don't have to go today, but you ought to go this week.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Last year I had to stay in bed for six days.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Then it is serious. The chemist is opposite the bank.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Should I take a painkiller now?

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Take one, not two. And you should drink more water.
